services.value: Provides radioanalytical services including analyses of air, water, milk, food crops, vegetation, soil, sediment, biota, bioassay, swipes, resins, filters, oil, waste, and other media, including unique sample matrices. Lists multiple report levels and associated analytical documentation such as report of analysis, sample receipt variance reports, raw sample data, blanks/spikes/duplicates/matrix spikes, calibration records, and annual/quarterly radiological environmental reports and quality assurance reports.
